capabilities.subset: Enumeration and resolution use the same current-state membership checks.
capabilities.restrictions: Protection, player hexproof and the complete targeting rules are outside this scope.

capabilities.subset: Choose one legendary permanent per name and controller; route losers to their owners without destruction/sacrifice.
capabilities.restrictions: Effects that waive or modify the legend rule and a general simultaneous-event pipeline are outside this scope.

capabilities.subset: Sorcery timing; queue activation; revalidate target and source at resolution.
capabilities.restrictions: Alternative equip permissions, reconfigure and general attachment effects are outside this scope.

capabilities.subset: Distinct physical cards in player zones, canonical casting origins, frozen zone references, owner preservation.
capabilities.restrictions: Definition lookups remain compatible with raw CardDef values. Temporary faces retain their physical front; general card permissions are not assessed.

capabilities.subset: Trigger delivery and paired identity-aware CardZone, stack and battlefield moves emit typed events with pre-move snapshots; action transactions buffer observers until commit.
capabilities.restrictions: Fixture insertion, removal without an eventual destination, card views and copies are not paired moves. No complete replay log or simultaneous-event scheduler.

capabilities.subset: Regeneration, no-regeneration restrictions, finality, marked exile and damaged-creature exile share replacement handling.
capabilities.restrictions: Only registered existing effects; no general printed-text replacement parser or arbitrary replacement interactions.

capabilities.subset: Target resolution, regeneration versus destruction, and bounce/reentry reset in mapped scenarios.
capabilities.restrictions: Protection, complete continuous layers and arbitrary removal restrictions remain outside this suite.

capabilities.subset: Owner routing, persist/undying references, activated self-return invalidation and entry counters.
capabilities.restrictions: Not every graveyard targeting permission, replacement or return mechanic is classified.

capabilities.description: Shared action dispatch and transactional engine costs
capabilities.subset: Action and legacy tuples share execution; can_perform probes that same path with rollback. Cast, general activation, legacy activation, loyalty and equip restore engine objects, zones, references, RNG and buffered events on failure. Required static targets are checked before costs.
capabilities.restrictions: Policy hooks must be pure choices; external policy state and process-local identity allocation are not rolled back. Low-level cast permits effect-granted timing; do_action enforces timing. Land plays, cycling and other special actions remain separate APIs. No complete cost-choice search or priority-permission model.

capabilities.description: Scoped continuous power/toughness and keyword ordering
capabilities.subset: Timestamped base P/T for animations and Cursed Roles; registered keyword grant/removal, base setting, modifiers, counters and switching; explicit same-layer dependencies, cycle fallback, source lifetimes, end-of-turn expiry and last-known P/T.
capabilities.restrictions: No copy/control/text/type/color layers, characteristic-defining effects, Oracle dependency inference or parser expansion. Registered keyword operations follow the existing keyword baseline; legacy keyword grants are not all timestamped. Dependencies must be supplied explicitly.

capabilities.description: Joint mana and supported sacrifice/craft planning
capabilities.subset: Enumerate supported required sacrifice sets and one craft material, reserve sources consumed for other costs, permit mana tapping before sacrifice, and choose an additional-mana alternative where supported. Spell and ability validation use the same plan as payment, including reserved X resources.
capabilities.restrictions: Uses existing mana, convoke, improvise and delve policies; no arbitrary multi-cost solver, mana-ability search or global X/resource optimization. Existing cost reduction formulas and optional cost policies retain their bounds.

capabilities.description: Scoped type, subtype and color layer views
capabilities.subset: Registered set/add/remove type, subtype and color operations are ordered in layers 4 and 5. Effective characteristics feed existing permanent rules checks; animations and crew use timestamps, copiable values exclude these effects, and departure retains last-known characteristics.
capabilities.restrictions: No Oracle parser for arbitrary type/color effects, automatic subtype/type association or land-type mana/ability changes. Callers supply subtype changes explicitly. Copy/control/text layers, characteristic-defining abilities and complete legacy timestamp integration remain outside scope.

capabilities.subset: Each upkeep, each player upkeep, each opponent upkeep, each end step and the end step queue APNAP triggers. Phase-player context routes supported effects; recognized intervening conditions are checked when triggered and on resolution. Source sacrifice and return work across opposing turns. Supported hand-size/life comparisons, tapped/untapped source state and absence of creatures with a supported keyword gate the complete trigger once at the start of resolution.
capabilities.restrictions: Two-player supported phases only; unsupported conditions, Madness and other unparsed clauses remain visible. No arbitrary phase scheduling, complete APNAP ordering choices or broad reflexive-trigger implementation. No arbitrary Boolean condition language, library-size gates, alternate-win effects or unrecognized creature predicates.

capabilities.description: Decayed blocking and delayed sacrifice, and supported token keyword lists
capabilities.subset: A creature with decayed cannot block. Declaring it as an attacker queues an attack trigger that creates a one-shot end-of-combat sacrifice trigger for the original permanent. Keyword removal, control changes and leaving/reentry respect that captured object and controller. Token keyword lists accept comma and conjunction forms while preserving unknown keyword gaps.
capabilities.restrictions: No devour, changeling or arbitrary keyword implementation is added. This does not implement general delayed-trigger scripting, Stifle card templates or every combat/ability-layer interaction.
